tasks.label: Recon: screen inventory
tasks.task:
GOAL: Produce a complete inventory of every user-facing screen/page in the Next.js app at /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status and flag which ones have responsive (mobile/tablet) problems.

CONTEXT: Next.js App Router project. Route groups exist at /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status/app/(public)/, app/(app)/, app/(auth)/, app/status/. Components live in /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status/components/ (subfolders: app-shell/, auth/, monitor/, logs/) plus top-level components like homepage.tsx, navbar.tsx, footer.tsx, company-monitor-page.tsx, outage-chart.tsx, outage-heat-map.tsx, mini-status-chart.tsx, outage-reporting.tsx, comments-section.tsx. Styling is Tailwind CSS (see app/globals.css, tailwind config, package.json).

DO NOT EDIT ANY FILES. This is read-only recon.

DO:
1. `find` / `ls` every page.tsx and layout.tsx under app/ and list the URL route each maps to.
2. For each page and its main components, grep for responsive red flags: fixed pixel widths (w-[NNNpx], min-w-[), hardcoded heights, `grid-cols-N` without sm:/md:/lg: variants, `flex-row` without wrapping, absent `overflow-x-auto` on tables, large `text-Nxl` without responsive scaling, `hidden`/`md:` misuse, fixed sidebars, position:fixed panels.
3. Report the Tailwind version and whether a tailwind.config file exists (and its breakpoints).
4. Confirm whether `<meta name="viewport">` is set in app/layout.tsx.

DELIVERABLE: A markdown report with (a) table of ROUTE -> primary file paths, (b) a per-file list of concrete responsive defects with file_path:line_number and the offending class string, (c) a severity ranking (HIGH = breaks layout / horizontal scroll on 375px, MED = cramped, LOW = polish), (d) a suggested grouping of the work into 4 independent buckets that do NOT touch the same files.

PROOF REQUIRED: [backend, files]. Include a section at the end titled "PROOF:" containing raw terminal output of your find/grep commands and the exact file_path:line_number references you cite. No claims without a grep hit or file excerpt backing them.

tasks.label: Recon: tooling + viewport
tasks.task:
GOAL: Determine how to build, run, and visually verify the app at /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status at mobile viewport sizes.

DO NOT EDIT APPLICATION CODE. Read-only investigation plus at most starting the dev server.

DO:
1. Read /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status/package.json and report the exact dev/build/lint/typecheck scripts and the Next.js + Tailwind + React versions.
2. Read /Users/rahul/Desktop/Projects/Website-status/AGENT_CONVENTIONS.md and SETUP.md and summarize any rules that constrain how UI code must be written (naming, styling conventions, component patterns). This is important — other workers must follow these.
3. Read app/layout.tsx and app/globals.css. Report: is the viewport meta / Next.js `viewport` export present and correct? Are there any global CSS rules that would cause horizontal overflow (fixed widths, min-width on body, overflow settings)?
4. Report the Tailwind breakpoint config (default or custom).
5. Try `npm run build` (or the project's typecheck script) and report whether the project currently compiles CLEANLY. Capture the exact output. This is the baseline other workers will be measured against.
6. Check whether Playwright or any browser automation is installed (grep package.json + look for playwright.config).

DELIVERABLE: A short markdown brief: commands to run the app, the current build status (pass/fail + errors), conventions other workers must follow, viewport/global-CSS findings, and whether screenshot verification is possible.

PROOF REQUIRED: [backend, files]. End with a section titled "PROOF:" containing the raw untruncated output of the build/typecheck command and verbatim excerpts of package.json scripts, the viewport export, and any relevant globals.css rules with file_path:line_number.
